benefit: Turn a spare iPhone into a camera that understands and acts
steps: Point the camera. Say what to watch for. Pick a Shortcut to run.
facts: Free · iPhone and iPad · Runs in the free Scriptable app · Uses Apple Intelligence or your own Claude or OpenAI key
bannerAlt: VisionX: Sees. Understands. Acts. A photo every few seconds goes in, AI looks at it and runs an Apple Shortcut when something happens. Two iPhone screens show a gate being watched and its triggers, inside viewfinder corners with a teal scan line and a red record dot.
